What We Are

The Festival That Feels Different

Most events put the creation on display. Mythos Events puts the creator in the room. Every festival we build is designed around one idea: direct, unmediated contact between the people who make things and the people who experience them.

The craftsperson is at the table. The improv performer riffs until the crowd is breathless. The local game designer is right there explaining the rules they wrote last month. Vendors, live performance, art displays, workshops, walk-throughs, open mic — every element is the same principle expressed differently.

"Museums show you what someone made. Festivals let you meet the person who made it."

Based in Glendale, Arizona. Built for dreamers, families, artists, and anyone who ever wanted to see behind the curtain.

Upcoming Events

The 2027–2028 Season

Three festivals. One year. Each one building on the last — shared performers, growing vendor families, and an audience that keeps coming back. Tickets sell in ascending tiers: the earlier you buy, the better the price.

October 2027  ·  Glendale, AZ

Shadowfest

The debut. A Halloween fantasy festival with walk-through experiences, glowing fairy and creature sculptures, costumed characters roaming the grounds, art displays, and a starry Arizona night sky above it all.

Tickets Coming Soon
December 2027  ·  Glendale, AZ

Winterfest

A Christmas fantasy market unlike anything you've seen. Glow-path lighting, a labyrinth built from giant gift boxes, fantasy winter characters, artisan vendors, live performance, and hot cocoa under the palms.

Tickets Coming Soon
Spring 2028  ·  Glendale, AZ

Easterfest

A spring creative arts festival blooming with color, storytelling, and wonder. Interactive characters, live performances, artisan makers, and a community of creators sharing their work with the world.

Get Involved

There's a Place for You in the Mythos

Mythos Events runs on collaboration. We don't just build festivals — we build a community of people who make things, perform things, and show up to share. If that sounds like you, we want to know you.

🎭

Performers

Improv artists, dancers, actors, musicians, costumed characters. If you can riff and adapt to a crowd, we especially want to talk to you.

🎨

Artists & Makers

Visual artists, sculptors, crafters, game designers, illustrators. Bring your work and be there to talk about it — that's the whole point.

🛖

Vendors

Artisan products, local food, handmade goods. Vendor spaces are ticketed on the same scaling model as guests — the earlier you commit, the better your rate.

🌟

Volunteers

Organizers, helpers, setup crew, ticket checkers. Behind-the-scenes roles that make every event possible. Great way to be part of something growing.

🎪

Workshop Leaders

Teach something. Crafts, improv games, storytelling, movement, art. A 20-minute workshop can change someone's day — or start a friendship.

✨

Dreamers

Have an idea that doesn't fit a category? Tell us anyway. Mythos Events started as an idea that didn't fit a category either.
